data.narrative:
Phantom Space is a growth-stage space and aerospace company founded by Jim Cantrell, Michael D'Angelo, and Michal Prywata. The sector comp universe includes 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, anchored by SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard valuation triangulation methods are not applicable here. Peer-median analysis cannot proceed: while 14 same-sector peers exist in Space & Aerospace, none of the narrow filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier—yielded three or more datapoints needed for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring, typically used via P/S multiples, is also unavailable because Phantom Space's revenue is not on file; the sector median P/S across the 6 public comps stands at 26.4x, but application requires disclosed revenue that private companies rarely provide.

Without revenue disclosure or a sufficiently dense peer cohort at the target's stage and tier, a quantitative valuation range cannot be synthesized from the available data. Any valuation estimate would require either (1) revenue or revenue guidance from the company, (2) access to recent private funding rounds or secondary transactions within the peer set, or (3) expansion of the comp universe to include earlier or later-stage space companies. Key uncertainties center on capital intensity, path to profitability, and the commercial viability of the company's specific technology or service within the broader aerospace ecosystem.
